summary_en: I-ne's board expressed support for and took a neutral stance on a management buyout by Jumbo Corporation at ¥2,248 per share over a 30-business-day period from November 24, 2026 to January 8, 2027, with the company expected to delist following completion.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support for and Neutral Stance Regarding Implementation of MBO
translation_en_brief: On November 20, 2026, I-ne's board of directors expressed support for a management buyout (MBO) to be conducted by Jumbo Corporation, a special-purpose entity established on October 26, 2026. The public tender offer targets all issued common shares of I-ne and certain warrant series (3rd, 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th series of share acquisition rights) at a fixed price of ¥2,248 per common share and ¥1 per warrant. The offer period runs for 30 business days from November 24, 2026 to January 8, 2027. The bidder has committed to acquiring all tendered securities without setting upper or lower thresholds. Jumbo Corporation is wholly owned by Jumbo Holdings Corporation, which in turn is wholly owned by Integral Holdings Corporation, ultimately controlled by an Integral Group structure comprising management and other investors aligned with the transaction. The board took a neutral stance on shareholder participation, delegating the decision to individual shareholders and warrant holders while confirming that delisting is expected to follow transaction completion. The board resolution was adopted with approval from all disinterested directors, including audit committee members, ensuring procedural fairness in the MBO process.
